      Read Me

      BOOM

      Aliens have taken over eight worlds. You're a space marine with an endless supply of bombs. Blow up every alien on the board to clear the level. Ten levels make a world, and the tenth is a boss. All 80 stages, their layouts and their aliens follow the original game. Play alone, with a friend on the same keyboard, or online with up to three friends.

      Controls

      Player 1
      ←↑→↓Move
      Space or XDrop a bomb (hold to keep dropping)
      Player 2 (same keyboard)
      WASDMove
      F or GDrop a bomb (hold to keep dropping)
      Game
      1 / 2Start a 1 or 2 player game
      P or EscPause
      OPlay online
      M / NSound effects / music on or off
      Alt+EnterFull screen
      Q (title screen)Back to the Arcade

      How to play

      Drop a bomb, then get out of the way. A few seconds later it explodes in a cross, as far as its range allows. The blast smashes crates, knocks out aliens and sets off other bombs it touches. It hurts you too, and the closer you are to the bomb, the more it hurts: standing on it costs half your health, the far end of a long blast just one heart. So don't stand in line with your own bomb.

      Unlike most bomb games, you don't die in one hit. Your health bar takes damage from blasts, alien shots and bites. Lose it all and you lose a life; you come back a moment later with a few seconds of shield. Bombs don't block anyone: you and the aliens walk straight through them. Walls and crates are solid, and many aliens shoot when they see you, so keep moving and use the walls.

      Every level has a clock. When it runs out, HURRY UP! flashes and the aliens speed up and shoot twice as often.

      Coins and EXTRA

      Pick up every coin on a level to start the EXTRA GAME: for 30 seconds every alien turns into a harmless blue blob, and each one you blow up drops a letter. Collect E, X, T, R and A for an extra life and 5,000 points. Letters you collect are kept from level to level.

      Power-ups

      Smashed crates sometimes leave a power-up behind. It lasts 10 seconds, and a blast destroys it. Lose a life and you lose your power-ups too: you're back to 4 bombs, a blast of 2 and a normal fuse.

          Scoring

          Aliens are worth 100 to 600 points, crates 10, coins 100 and power-ups 100. When the last alien falls, the clock stops and you get 4 more seconds to grab coins, letters and power-ups (bombs still hurt). Then the level ends and adds 10 points for every second left on the clock. An extra life every 50,000 points.

          Difficulty

          Pick Easy, Medium or Hard before you start: Left and Right on the title screen, or Options › Difficulty. Easy gives more power-ups, fewer aliens, more time and gentler hits. Hard is the other way round.

          Playing online

          Choose Game › Play Online… (or press O). Your friend code is shown there and on the Arcade dashboard. Swap codes with your friends once, and you'll see who is online. One player presses Host a game; friends join from their list, by typing the host's code, or from an invite. When everyone's in, the host presses Start game. Up to 4 can play. If your copies of the game are different versions, the newer one is passed to the older one automatically: save it over your old copy and open it again.

          BOOM is a fan tribute for personal use, inspired by the 1990s Macintosh shareware game BOOM by Federico Filipponi (FactorSoftware). All art, music and sound here are new.
